summary: Reject uncovered offline query scopes, compare complete facility handoffs, and find the newest compatible origin-aware cache pair.
reason: A complete saved board covers only its declared source request; empty queries and automatic pairing must not imply evidence outside that scope, and facility map changes are material planning changes.
validated_outcome: Regression cases distinguish uncovered from covered-empty searches, detect facility/map-only changes, and choose older or competing compatible origin pairs without network requests.
